onboarding.title: Find your baseline
onboarding.copy: One maximum static hold sizes your tables. Mark the first contraction, then keep holding until you need to breathe. After that, choose a plan or build your own. Keep CO2 and O2 on different days.

onboarding.o2Copy: Holds get longer each round. Rest stays fixed.

plan.switchLost: Previous plan progress will be lost.

plan.rule: Start with 2–3 sessions a week. Never train CO2 and O2 on the same day.
plan.customFrequencySeparate: {count} sessions a week, on separate days
plan.methodBeginnerMarked: Hold {time}, your first contraction, for 7 rounds. Rest steps from 2:00 to 0:30. After week 2 the hold adds 15–20 seconds.
plan.methodBeginnerUnmarked: Hold {time}, half your maximum, since no contraction was marked, for 7 rounds. Rest steps from 2:00 to 0:30. After week 2 the hold adds 15–20 seconds.
plan.detailCustom: The same sessions repeat each week.
plan.detailIntermediateRetestNow: Retake the baseline this week so the intervals can move.

plan.retestLink: Retake your baseline this week so the intervals can move.

beginner.name: 4-week plan
beginner.method: A no-contraction table: the hold stays at your first contraction for 7 rounds, and rest steps from 2:00 to 0:30. After week 2 the hold adds 15–20 seconds.

intermediate.name: 8-week plan
intermediate.frequency: 3–4 sessions a week, on separate days
intermediate.focus: Keep building CO2 tolerance, and add O2 tables.
intermediate.method: CO2 holds sit at 60–75% of your maximum. O2 rest stays at 2:00 while holds climb to 80%. Retake the baseline in week 4.

advanced.name: 12-week plan
advanced.frequency: 4 sessions a week, with a full day off
advanced.focus: Peak adaptation, and a way through a plateau.
advanced.method: Alternate standard CO2 and O2 with one-breath tables at about 40% of your best, plus dry apnea walks.

custom.name: Your plan
custom.focus: Build the length and the sessions yourself.
custom.method: Pick how many weeks, and which of CO2, O2, one-breath, and dry walks repeat every week.

note.beginnerUnmarkedEarly: No contraction was marked, so the hold starts at half your maximum. Rest steps from 2:00 to 0:30.
note.beginnerUnmarkedWeek3: No contraction was marked. The hold is 15 seconds past half your maximum.
note.beginnerUnmarkedWeek4: No contraction was marked. The hold is 20 seconds past half your maximum.
note.beginnerMarkedEarly: No-contraction table. The hold is your first contraction, and rest steps from 2:00 to 0:30.
note.beginnerMarkedWeek3: The hold is 15 seconds past your first contraction.
note.beginnerMarkedWeek4: The hold is 20 seconds past your first contraction.
note.co2: Hold stays in the 60–75% band. Rest steps down. Keep this on a different day from O2.
note.o2: Rest stays at 2:00. Holds climb, and the last one stays at or under 80% of your maximum.
note.oneBreath: About 40% of your best. Take one recovery breath, then hold again.
note.walk: Walk during each hold. Stand still while you recover.

baseline.title: Baseline
baseline.copy: Sit or lie down. Breathe calmly, take one full inhale, then start. Leave the screen on. This is a dry static.
baseline.warning: Stay out of the water. Stop if you feel unwell.
baseline.firstCopy: Tap when the first urge to breathe arrives. That is usually a contraction in the diaphragm. Before it, the hold is the relaxation phase: it still feels easy. The contraction starts the struggle phase, when the urge to breathe takes over. Beginner CO2 tables use this time so each hold stays in the relaxation phase.
baseline.thenCopy: Continue until you must breathe. That total time is the maximum the tables are built from.
baseline.enterCopy: Use a max hold and first contraction you already know. The tables are sized from these two times.
baseline.firstSectionCopy: This is the moment the first urge to breathe arrives. Before it, you are in the relaxation phase and the hold still feels easy. After it, you are in the struggle phase. Beginner CO2 tables hold at this time so training stays in the relaxation phase.
baseline.withoutIt: Without it, beginner tables use half your maximum.
baseline.tooShort: Too short to size a table
baseline.tooShortCopy: That hold was {time}. Stay with it for at least {minimum} so the CO2 hold can sit at half of a real maximum.
baseline.co2Hold: Hold {hold} every round. Rest starts at {start} and drops by {step}, down to {end}.
baseline.o2Climb: Holds climb from {first} to {last}. Rest stays {rest}.
baseline.o2Default: Holds get longer each round. Rest stays fixed.
baseline.explainMidpoint: No contraction marked. The CO2 hold is {hold}.
baseline.explainContraction: First contraction at {at}, inside 50–60% of your maximum. The CO2 hold is {hold}.
baseline.explainBelow: First contraction at {at}, before the halfway point. The CO2 hold stays at {hold}.
baseline.explainAbove: First contraction at {at}, after 60% of your maximum. The CO2 hold stays at {hold}.
baseline.timerCue: Tap the first button at the first contraction.
baseline.timerMarked: Contraction at {time}. Hold until you need to breathe.
